title: Cloudways Coupon Code: 80% Off for 2 Months (Checked Nov 2026)
excerpt: Cloudways shows code BFCM802 for 80% off for two months. Here is what each plan costs for those months, what it costs after, and the free trial.

meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Cloudways coupon code for Black Friday 2026: 80% off for 2 months with code BFCM802, what each plan costs with the offer, the free trial and the end date.
meta.rl_answer: Cloudways shows 80% off for 2 months with code BFCM802 on its pricing page. The discount lasts two months, and the page shows no end date.
meta.rl_faqs:
What is the Cloudways coupon code? | Cloudways' pricing page shows 80% off for 2 months with the code BFCM802. We read it on 15 November 2026.
How long does the Cloudways offer last? | The discount covers the first 2 months of a plan. The page we read shows no end date for the offer, so check it before you buy.
How much is Cloudways with the 80% off? | A Micro plan on DigitalOcean is $2.80 a month for 2 months, then $14. Small is $5.60, Medium $10.80 and Large $19.80 for the first 2 months.
Does Cloudways have a free trial? | Yes, 5 days on Flexible plans with no card and 3 days on Autonomous plans.
Does the code work for existing customers? | We could not confirm that. The offer is shown for plans on the pricing page. Ask Cloudways support if you already have an account.
meta.rl_sources: Cloudways: pricing and Black Friday offer (read 15 Nov 2026) | https://www.cloudways.com/en/pricing.php

The pricing page shows 80% off for 2 months with code BFCM802.
A Micro plan is $2.80 a month for 2 months, then $14.

A 5-day free trial is listed on Flexible plans.
